usage:
one command per call: compare A B -> -1|0|1; satisfies V RANGE -> true|false; valid V; parse V -> JSON; sort V... ; max RANGE V...
JSON form: {"op":"compare","args":["1.2.0","1.10.0"]}
in: compare <a> <b> | satisfies <v> <range> | valid <v> | parse <v> | sort <v>... | max <range> <v>...
out: one line (or one version per line for sort); error: ... with exit 1
